definitions.explanation: The hottest part of summer, roughly mid-July through August in Japan.

examples.japanese: {真夏|まなつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧。
{真夏|まなつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暑|あつ}くて→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}たくない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: In midsummer it's so hot I don't want to go outside.

examples.japanese: {真夏|まなつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三十五度|さんじゅうごど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the middle of summer, daytime temperatures can exceed 35 degrees.

notes:
Formed with the prefix {真|ま}- (true, exact), which here marks the peak of the season — compare ⟦{真冬|まふゆ}→真冬：20587_mafuyu⟧ (midwinter) and ⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧ (the dead of night).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真夏|まなつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧: the midsummer heat
- {真夏|まなつ}{日|び}: a day with a high of 30°C or above

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盛夏|せいか}→盛夏：19161_seika⟧: high summer — more formal and literary
- ⟦{晩夏|ばんか}→晩夏：19623_banka⟧: late summer
